name: Alanndarian Nightsong
summary: In Auberdine, Alanndarian Nightsong tends to Darkshore's sickened wildlife. She works with travelers to ease the afflictions spreading through the region, especially among its deer.

sections.title: A Caretaker in Auberdine
sections.body: Alanndarian Nightsong watches over Darkshore's wildlife from the coastal settlement of Auberdine. Taints in the soil and water have left creatures of the ancient woods sick and strangely aggressive. She seeks ways to ease their suffering and restore their strength.

sections.title: Healing the Stricken and Sick
sections.body: Alanndarian searches for what is making Darkshore's animals ill. She gathers plants and studies the region's water sources, then prepares salves and healing draughts. Travelers help her apply these cures to ailing creatures, in hopes of stopping the corruption from overtaking the wildlife.

faq.answer: Alanndarian Nightsong cares for Darkshore's afflicted wildlife from Auberdine. She seeks herbal cures for the unnatural sickness spreading along the coast.

faq.q: Where can Alanndarian Nightsong be found?
faq.answer: Alanndarian Nightsong lives in Auberdine, the main night elf settlement on Darkshore's foggy coast.

faq.q: What tasks does she ask adventurers to perform?
faq.answer: Alanndarian asks travelers to find sources of sickness, gather healing ingredients, and give remedies to ailing animals such as the sickly deer.

faq.q: Is she related to other Nightsongs?
faq.answer: Other night elves share the Nightsong name, but no known tie confirms Alanndarian is related to them. She devotes her days to Darkshore's wilderness.

faq.q: Why are the creatures in Darkshore sick?
faq.answer: Polluted water from Cliffspring Falls, Darkshore's main drinking water source, has sickened deer across the region. Alanndarian suspects a greater taint is at work as well.
Though rumor credits her with great knowledge of striders, Alanndarian does not train hunters' tamed pets. Her attention remains on wild populations.

angles.text: For Alliance travelers arriving in Auberdine, Alanndarian helps explain the fragile state of northern Kalimdor's wilderness.
As a night elf, Alanndarian's care for the forest and its corrupted wildlife reflects kaldorei ideals of preservation.
As a druid, you share Alanndarian's search for taints in the water and her work to heal poisoned creatures across Darkshore.
As a hunter, you can help Alanndarian track wild striders and distressed game by reading the beasts' signs.
